subject: Rates moved — your last deal might pencil now
preheader: A 60-second re-check on the one that almost worked.
headline: Still hunting deals?
body: It's been a few weeks since your last TrueCap run. Mortgage rates have moved since then — which means a deal that almost worked might cash-flow now, or one that looked great might not anymore.
If you've got a listing sitting in your inbox, paste the address and re-underwrite it in 60 seconds. No spreadsheet, no setup.
And if TrueCap isn't fitting how you invest, just reply and tell me why — it genuinely helps me make it better.
